kinds.a: air cleaner · HEPA purifier · purifying fan · air deodoriser · ion generator · ioniser
kinds.d: Movable appliance that filters or treats room air to remove particles, odours and gases; sold by room size, CADR and filter grade.
t: purifier-humidifier 2-in-1 (Philips 3000i, Dyson PH03, Sharp KC series)
ioniser / plasma (Sharp Plasmacluster, Winix PlasmaWave, Daikin Streamer)
deodoriser (hypochlorous-acid air treatment, e.g. Panasonic ziaino)
medical-grade HEPA with heavy carbon (IQAir HealthPro, Austin Air)
smart / app-controlled with sensors (Xiaomi, Levoit S models)
r: Blue Pure, Blue Signature, HealthProtect and Classic Pro

kinds.a: purifier filter · HEPA filter cartridge · carbon filter · humidifier wick · dehumidifier filter
kinds.d: Consumable filter or wick made to fit a specific air purifier, humidifier or dehumidifier; genuine maker filters or cheaper third-party equivalents.
t: speciality variants (pet allergy, smoke, toxin absorber)
m: Core 300 replacement filter (Original, Pet Allergy, Smoke Remover, Toxin Absorber)

kinds.a: IAQ monitor · CO2 monitor · PM2.5 monitor · air quality sensor
kinds.d: Small room device that measures carbon dioxide, fine particles, VOCs, humidity or radon and shows readings on a display or app; CO alarms sit in B8, weather stations in E6.
t: multi-sensor smart monitor (PM2.5, CO2, VOC, temperature, humidity)

brands.d: Seoul appliance maker founded as Woongjin Coway; its Airmega AP-1512HH Mighty has been Wirecutter's top air-purifier pick for over a decade.
Stockholm air-purifier brand acquired by Unilever in 2016; HEPASilent filtration, Blue Pure range, named top brand by Consumer Reports in 2025.
VeSync's home-air brand; the Core 300 family is the best-selling budget HEPA purifier line.
South Korean air-treatment maker known for True HEPA purifiers with PlasmaWave ionisation.
American industrial group whose licensed home-comfort line includes the HPA series HEPA purifiers.
Founded by James Dyson in Wiltshire, now Singapore-based; purifiers double as bladeless fans, humidifiers or heaters.
Swiss air-quality company founded by the Hammes brothers; HealthPro Plus with HyperHEPA filtration is the reference high-end purifier.
Buffalo, New York maker of steel-cased purifiers with medical HEPA and unusually large activated-carbon beds.
Eindhoven-founded electronics group; its numbered air-purifier series include 2-in-1 purifier-humidifiers.
Osaka electronics maker, Foxconn-owned since 2016; Plasmacluster ion technology runs through its purifiers, humidifying purifiers and ion generators.
Osaka HVAC giant, world's largest by sales; its room purifiers use Streamer plasma discharge with long-life electrostatic HEPA filters.
Beijing consumer-electronics group; Smart Air Purifier line offers app control at low prices.
Florida company selling PECO photoelectrochemical purifiers; independent tests by Wirecutter and Consumer Reports rated them poorly.
Osaka electronics group; ziaino hypochlorous-acid air-treatment units target odours and microbes.
Guardian Technologies brand of tower purifiers with HEPA filters and UV-C lamps; among Consumer Reports' top-rated brands.
Maker of radon and indoor air-quality monitors; View Plus combines radon, PM2.5, CO2, VOC, temperature, humidity and pressure sensors.
Maker of the Aranet4 Home, a battery CO2 monitor with NDIR sensor and e-ink display that became the reference consumer CO2 meter.
Smart air-quality monitor brand; the Element also integrates with Trane HVAC systems.
Swedish furniture retailer whose Vindstyrka sensor shows PM2.5, TVOC, temperature and humidity and links to the Dirigera hub and Starkvind purifier.
Budget smart-monitor brand; Air Monitor Lite reads PM2.5, PM10, CO2, temperature and humidity with HomeKit support.
